conclusions: Both notebooks remain g530, protected service/input READY, and on the same authenticated connection as installation. Current agent logs show zero new source heartbeat failures, reconnects, session faults or recovery-required events in the recorded interval.

Stability and latency differ: twelve detailed g530 pairs complete OK and all 393 receiver dispatches in those pairs are under 10ms. B worst-input per-entry median/max is 3.337/4.941ms, compared with 10.444/211.206ms across five complete g529 pairs. The original three pre-work g529 pairs had 3.989/10.444ms; workloads/sample lengths differ.

B ready wait is essentially unchanged: median/max 22.355/25.529ms -> 22.334/25.686ms. All twelve g530 receiver startup profiles report prepared workers; background startup/hash durations are not added to this critical-path wait.

A capture latency did not improve in this trial: median/max 26.334/68.262ms -> 52.5575/225.112ms. This is an observed difference, not proof that the g530 code change caused a regression under controlled equal load.

The 225.112ms A capture sample contains 215.230ms worker activation, with 170.544ms foreground request nested inside activation. Its local request delivery is only 0.047ms; reply delivery is 0.058ms. This local capture tail is concentrated in native/window activation, not a 225ms network transmission.
A first-offer-since-begin median/max is 111.2015/283.692ms. It includes physical input availability/user movement and is not pure protocol latency or display latency.

The nearby A runtime summary records 47.481ms timer lateness, 108.156ms sampler lateness and two runnable-delay samples in the >10ms..<=100ms bucket. These support scheduling pressure as a possibility, but do not identify a particular blocked Windows API or prove CPU/GC causation.

TCP RTT median/max in matched g530 source snapshots is 6.1725/29.534ms. No profile reports TCP timeout episodes or retransmitted-byte deltas. WiFi and host scheduling remain possible contributors to grant waits, but do not explain the separately measured local 170.544ms foreground span.
The previous installation-time B network acquire timeouts are preserved as preconnection events. Historical recovery lastFailure data is not reclassified as new g530 service failure.
